assemblyInstructions: Do not run legacy tests/ui_contract.py or tests/ui_observe.py: their old1.1 IDs/native maps do not implement current1.5 contract.
Use only measured observed dictionaries, actual ControlType/native inventory and hashes; never expected.value/op or overall PASS labels as actual.
Keep unknown/mismatched/missing data as findings/notMeasured. Keep absent9aggregate/Dialog inventory items absent until directly evidenced.
measurementSources contains actual getter/helpers and assembler code only; records belong in evidence/sourceRecords. Current saved getter imports no local helper code.
Do not remeasure unchanged475 or finishedPDF work merely to fill a counter. A new product artifact invalidates prior measurements and needs exact-candidate measurements.
Final environment requires measured platform/renderer/DPI/scale/client viewport. Do not infer96DPI or copy old screenshot dimensions.
Root performs native input only after user noninterference confirmation. Record initial state/actions/observed raw and focused target, before/after DB or file state and current hashes.
Combine only independently evidenced property values. A partially evidenced rule stays partial; untested state branches/counters/IME/clipboard stay missing.
Formal ui-observations remains unpublished until the native measurement stage is authorized/complete; no UI gate PASS or outputs publication follows from this plan.
